messages:
Emily (finance): FYI AcmeCorp submitted a dispute: their private deployment portal shows ~30% more tokens than our portal for Feb invoice. They want an adjustment or credit. Attaching the customer's note: 'we see 2.1B tokens; your invoice shows 1.6B'. Can someone triage?
Sam (acct mgmt): Do we know if this is usage ingestion or platform-fee proration mismatch? Invoice #AC-2025-02-118.
Emily (finance): Customer says it's purely usage (token metering) — they called out the agent on their side vs our metering. They asked for a one-time credit if our numbers are wrong.
Raj (sales): Put me on the thread; this account is on a private on-prem deployment with platform fee + metered usage. They'll escalate if we lock invoices.
Maria (ops): I'll check agent metrics. Quick note: we rolled out agent v2.3.1 to a subset on 2025-02-10 which had a patch for batched reporting. Possible drop if backlog handling regressed.
Maria (ops): Running the comparison script now: `./tools/compare_metering --customer acmecorp --start 2025-02-01 --end 2025-02-28`. Will paste results.
billing-bot: Job started: compare_metering: id=cmp-2025-02-acmecorp-1, queued.
Maria (ops): Output (summary): our_ingested_tokens=1,612,238,450; customer_reported_tokens=2,094,810,321; delta=+482,571,871 tokens (~29.9%). Suspect missing backfill for 2025-02-10..2025-02-12 window on a subset of hosts.
Sam (acct mgmt): That delta looks big. What's the USD delta with their billing profile?
Maria (ops): Using customer price $0.00002/token (their contract), delta_amount = 482,571,871 * 0.00002 = $9,651.44. Also platform fee is fixed so no change there.
Emily (finance): Okay so ~$9.65k — we need approval path to issue a one-time credit vs a true-up on next invoice. Policy question: for private deployments, do we auto-credit metering agent failures?
Raj (sales): For strategic accounts like AcmeCorp we usually offer a credit once ops confirms agent bug. Sales prefers credit plus a note that we've patched the agent to avoid churn. I'll handle comms after finance signs off.
Sam (acct mgmt): I'll need a formal memo for the credit: reason, amount, timeline, GL code. Emily can you prepare? Also cc legal if wording or contract changes.
Emily (finance): Drafting memo now. Proposed action: Issue a $9,651.44 one-time invoice credit, record as Billing Adjustment (GL: 4105), and flag for a tech follow-up. Reason: undercount due to agent backfill failure (ops confirmed).
Maria (ops): Confirmed root cause: v2.3.1 had a retry backoff regression; backlog flush was aborted for affected hosts for ~36h. Patch released v2.3.2 and queued backfill for missing window. We will flush backfill and push to billing pipeline — could increase ingested tokens after backfill. Recommend issuing provisional credit now and reconcile after backfill completes.
billing-bot: Backfill job scheduled: id=backfill-2025-02-acmecorp-1, eta 3h. status=scheduled.
Sam (acct mgmt): Can we do provisional credit with a note: 'provisional credit subject to final backfill reconciliation within 7 days'? Customer OK with that? Raj: pls confirm.
Raj (sales): Customer rep on call accepted a provisional credit while ops runs backfill. They'll hold off on collections.
Emily (finance): OK I'll prepare a one-line credit memo and the credit memo entry. Draft below: 
```
Credit Memo: ACME-CR-2025-02-1
Amount: $9,651.44
Reason: One-time adjustment for verified metering undercount due to agent v2.3.1 backlog flush regression (02/10/2025 - 02/12/2025).
Action: Provisional credit issued; final reconciliation to occur after backfill completion (<= 7 days).
GL: 4105
Approver: Finance manager (Emily)
```
Emily (finance): Requesting approval to issue provisional credit now. :please-approve: @Sam @Raj
Sam (acct mgmt): Approved from AM side. Please cc invoice note and set status = provisional. :thumbsup:
Raj (sales): Approved from sales and customer success. I'll coordinate the customer message.
Emily (finance): Approved — issuing credit. Creating credit memo now and posting adjustment to AR.
billing-bot: Credit memo created: ACME-CR-2025-02-1, amount=9651.44, status=provisional, created_by=emily.
Maria (ops): Backfill job running. I'll post final ingestion numbers when complete.
billing-bot: Backfill completed: added_tokens=481,900,112; new_ingested_total=2,094,138,562; reconciliation_delta_post_backfill =  -671,759 (i.e., remaining difference ~0.03%).
Maria (ops): Final check: after backfill our total is within 0.03% of customer's reported numbers. The large portion of the delta resolved.
Emily (finance): Final reconciliation confirms provisional credit covered the delta; difference <$100. I'll settle the credit and mark as final. Posting final journal entries and closing thread.
Sam (acct mgmt): Thanks team. I'll update AcmeCorp and close the dispute.
Raj (sales): Will send customer note and confirm CS follow-up.
Emily (finance): Closing — cc:legal for records. :white_check_mark:
